notes: Every stage file is now fetched from a commit-pinned path, not a branch path with a changing query string. The loader asks api.github.com which commit main is on once at startup, then loads <repo>/<sha>/core/..., which is a path no cache has ever seen. The rev query alone was not enough: a cache that keys by path treated tail/admin.lua?v=55 and ?v=54 as the same entry, so the header could say 55 while a page came back from the previous build. If the ref lookup fails the plain base is used, so an offline or rate-limited client still loads, just without the guarantee. Set getgenv().AetherDebug to see which base was chosen.
